🚀 plainpad | PHP
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a private and secure self-hosted solution for individuals and teams to manage their notes.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted note taking • Data ownership • Simplicity and stability • Docker setup
📖 Summary: Plainpad is a self-hosted note-taking application built with PHP and React, offering users full ownership of their data. It emphasizes simplicity and stability, running on the user's own server.
